scope: Robinhood identity inventory: 16 current publisher-directory entries, one historical license-auction generation and three evidence-backed administrative/shared dependencies; not a chain census or stored live state.

explorer_policy.verification_access: Follow each record explorer_url for a publication check or report unavailable. This catalog stores no explorer verdicts or contract write interface; requested evidence artifacts belong outside the installed runtime with their provenance and as-of time.

shared_evidence_limits.applies_to: Every record; read with selected records
shared_evidence_limits.source_correspondence: Check publication and exact source/bytecode correspondence on demand or report unavailable; publisher identity attribution does not establish either.
shared_evidence_limits.current_ownership_and_privileges: Use on-demand reads for selected owner getters and fresh evidence for the privilege structure; no current ownership or privilege observations are stored here.
shared_evidence_limits.proxy_and_implementation_relationships: Historical dependency provenance identifies research targets only. Refresh ownership, implementation, Safe signers/threshold/modules/guards and privilege evidence for current claims; an administrative SafeProxy does not establish proxy-upgradeable monetary modules.
shared_evidence_limits.audit_to_deployment_correspondence: Require fresh evidence; not established by identity attribution.
shared_evidence_limits.current_activation_and_market_state: Use an on-demand snapshot or report unavailable; no live state or fallback observation is stored in this identity catalog.
shared_evidence_limits.infrastructure: Shared infrastructure is not project-authored merely because listed; the pool manager is not a unique canonical pool.
shared_evidence_limits.actions: This catalog supplies research identity and navigation, not operational authorization. Host-authorized supplemental research, unsigned preparation and nonbroadcast simulation are allowed; no wallet signing, signature requests or transaction submission/broadcast, including delegation.
